title: Services Retainers
description: Monthly retainer tier cards pulling from the Services CPT.

intro.default: Retainers give you a reserved block of hours each month at a reduced rate, with guaranteed response times and a dedicated point of contact who already knows your systems.

retainerTermsText.default: Retainers are billed monthly. Unused hours do not roll over but can be applied to a prepaid hour bank at the discounted retainer rate. Retainers require a 3-month minimum commitment. Cancellation with 30 days notice after the initial term.
